definitions.gloss: company resort lodge; recreation facility; rest home
definitions.explanation: A lodge, usually at a hot spring or the seaside, that a company, union or public body runs so that its members and their families can stay cheaply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養所|ほようじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at the company's resort lodge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{保養所|ほようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The company has a resort lodge in Hakone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{保養所|ほようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: These days more and more companies are selling off their resort lodges to cut costs.

notes:
⟦{保養|ほよう}→保養：11574_hoyou⟧ (rest, recuperation) + ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place; voiced じょ here). A typical perk of large Japanese companies and public-sector unions from the postwar boom years: employees and their families could stay at a hot-spring or seaside lodge for a small fee. Many have since been sold off.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養所|ほようじょ}: a company resort lodge
- {保養所|ほようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use a resort lodge
- ⟦{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧: employee benefits (the category it belongs to)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {療養所|りょうようじょ}: sanatorium — for medical treatment, not holidays
- ⟦{別荘|べっそう}→別荘：11786_bessou⟧: a private holiday home
